title: Ashen - Update v0.1.18
author: bando ✮
contents:
[h3]✨ New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fish basket and meal basket icons redrawn in a cleaner pixel-art style
[*] Stat icons added throughout the UI
[*] Equipment slots now show a rarity-colored border on the character sheet
[*] Smoother, more natural camera
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46288169/79d471dd6ae7ea5d800284da0743cb560ca3eb89.gif[/img]

[h3]⚖️ Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gear strengthened
[*] Wisdom replaced by a new Defense stat
[*] Agility's speed bonus corrected
[*] Calciné's set bonus reworked
[*] Cooked fish dishes now grant a short combat buff instead of only restoring HP
[/list]

[h3]🐛 Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare save-corruption issue on slow loads
[*] Fixed several cases where a full inventory could cause items to be lost
[*] The equipment vault no longer reshuffles your stored items on load
[*] Fixed Steam Rich Presence freezing on old values
[*] Fixed the cooking screen darkening more each time it's reopened
[*] Fixed a fishing quest that could trigger before the island was reachable
[*] The dungeon recap screen now shows the correct translated name
[/list]

title: Ashen - Update v0.1.15
author: bando ✮
contents:
[h3]✨ New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Korean and Polish added (10 languages now supported)
[*] Mison gives two new quests: an introduction to the talent tree and to the bestiary
[*] Harvey gives a new quest introducing the dungeon log (per-dungeon badges)
[*] Olf gives a new quest showing how to upgrade equipment (merge two duplicates into a stronger piece)
[*] Abel and Kawett now point you to the Recipes and Professions menus at the end of their quest chains
[*] Buy seeds from Kawett in bulk (x1/5/10/25/50/100)
[*] Profession level-up popup shows the exact bonus (cursor speed, success gauge size) and the key to open the Professions tab
[*] Quest/menu key hints now show the correct key for keyboard or gamepad
[/list]

[h3]⚖️ Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Golem's ground slam radius halved
[*] Golem AoE (craters and ground slam) no longer lands on water
[*] Death no longer costs XP
[*] Crater Maw badges tab stays locked until Crypt of Braise level 5 is cleared
[/list]

[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Golem Fragment quest item getting stuck in inventory after turning in Emma's quest
[*] Fixed a grey screen sometimes appearing right after loading into the world
[*] Fixed the Dungeon tab's scroll also scrolling the quest tracker behind it
[*] Fixed live language switching not retranslating NPC chat lines
[*] Fixed missing Korean/Polish quest titles and descriptions (were falling back to English)
[*] Fixed language button alignment in Settings
[/list]
